For a 50-person Indian company, Trip.Biz is more directly comparable with corporate TMCs than ordinary Trip.com Flights. Current public pricing is largely quote-based, so the meaningful comparison is the fee structure and what is included.

Option	Current price	Exclusions / watch-outs	Best for
Trip.Biz	Custom quote	Airline/hotel fare, taxes and supplier cancellation fees; verify transaction/service fees and India GST invoicing	Tech-first teams needing global inventory + 24/7 support
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply	Supplier cancellation rules; some international-LCC GST invoices require direct airline follow-up	Indian SMBs wanting easy adoption and strong domestic inventory 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1

FCM Travel India	Custom quote	Verify implementation, transaction, after-hours and offline-booking charges	Companies wanting a full-service TMC, policy control and traveller safety 
FCM Travel

Corporate Traveller India	Custom quote	Verify transaction fees, offline servicing and international support	SMEs wanting a dedicated human travel-management team; it is FCM’s SME-focused sister brand 
FCM Travel

Important: ask all four for an all-in quote against the same annual travel volume. Trip.Biz explicitly offers online/offline booking, approvals, reporting and 24/7 support. 
Trip.biz
+1

For a 50-person company, I’d specifically compare per-booking fee + cancellation/amendment fee + after-hours fee + payment fee + GST invoicing + credit terms before choosing.
